description: This file defines a custom form field type for Symfony forms called MultipleTypeaheadType. It extends CollectionType and adds specific configuration and view logic for handling multiple typeahead inputs, including options for sources, labels, and HTML attributes.

classes.name: MultipleTypeaheadType
classes.description: Custom Symfony form type extending CollectionType for multiple typeahead inputs with configurable options.

methods.name: configureOptions
methods.description: Sets default options for the form type, including sources, label attributes, and value fields.

methods.name: buildView
methods.description: Prepares the form view by setting CSS classes, IDs, and other variables needed for rendering.

methods.name: getBlockPrefix
methods.description: Returns the block prefix used for form theming.
